verdicts.reason: A: the Lumen & Fig logo has shrunk to an illegible speck at the bottom of the card, so the brand is effectively lost. The 'NEW NIGHT SERUM' eyebrow sits below the body copy, so the reading order is wrong, and the bottle is cropped at the bottom with the card floating awkwardly. B: the logo stays readable and in proportion, but it has the same eyebrow-below-body order problem. Its card is jammed against the top, right and bottom canvas edges, and the bottle runs into the top edge and is cropped at the bottom, so the edges need margin fixes before it could ship.
